findings.what: After 12:00Z there is no logged E10 policy, and E10 detection gets weaker. The e10 watch loop stops at 12:00Z (e10_watch_loop.py END). From then on, public notebooks are seen only by the 90-min feed. The feed searches 'biohub' across ALL of Kaggle and drops titles that contain xgboost/lgbm/optuna/stacking, so a real biohub notebook with 'stacking' in its title would be missed silently. Timing makes a late E10 moot for the user's tick anyway. Kaggle itself allows selection until 23:59Z. The 08:28Z entry covers only candidates that appear before 12:00Z, so a flag at ~13:00Z would leave the session with no rule.

findings.what: The 17:40Z pre_exp89t save job (pid 18408) can skip the primary S0 on a transient poller error. It tests only the LAST poll.log block for '^56669888,.*PENDING'. An error block (429 or DNS; two occurred today at 05:34Z and 05:46Z) has no ref lines. The job would then print 'exp89t no longer PENDING: no pre-save' and exit. It also does not retry a failed 'uptest.py save' (a 429 on the download raises in load()). The impact is bounded: the 11:45Z e10_1141Z fallback S0 still exists. It is stale by ~6.5 h, which biases k toward 0 but can never create a false UP, because tools/uptest.py compare counts only teams above us in S0 that are below us in S1, and public bests never fall.
findings.evidence: Win32_Process 18408 command line: 'if last | grep -qE "^56669888,.*PENDING"; then ... uptest.py save pre_exp89t; else echo "exp89t no longer PENDING: no pre-save"'; experiments/lb_poll/poll.log error headers at lines 28681/28683 (2026-09-29T05:34:41Z, 05:46:17Z) with no ref rows; tools/uptest.py save() has no retry.
findings.action: Before 17:40Z, kill pid 18408/35124 and re-arm with the inverse condition: save unless the newest NON-ERROR block (last '=== ' header without '[') shows 56669888 as COMPLETE or ERROR. If the save's output lacks 'SubmissionCount', retry once after 5 min (the same 2-download cap as R35-A1). This costs at most 1-2 read-only LB downloads, the same as the current plan.

findings.what: This is a conditional gap that applies only if the user says yes to a slot-2 file at 11:50-12:00Z. That file (e.g. exp89s, non-CI) would read ~19:00-19:12Z, after exp89t (~18:17-18:29Z). If it reads 0.959, it needs an attributable UP over exp87a with an S0 of count 57 taken after exp89t's completion. The only planned post-exp89t save (watcher 29636) runs only if exp89t reads exactly 0.959. Without such a save, a 0.959 exp89s is MASKED and cannot become V_pub. If exp89t is still PENDING when exp89s completes, a single +1 count step is exp89s's own and stays attributable. If both complete inside one save window (count +2), the result is MASKED.
